summary: No blocking duplicate and no in-flight conflict on lib/apa or lib/uat: captured_cause exists nowhere in tracked EHG_Engineer files, sd_conflict_matrix is empty, and every open PR touching walker paths is changelog/docs only. CONDITIONAL because three of six FRs are materially mis-scoped against already-merged code: FR-4 is roughly half delivered by altifyai PR #94 (QF-20260906-986, status=completed) and its remaining written spec CONFLICTS with the shipped security decision; FR-2 is roughly 90 percent pre-written in altifyai one-shot-secret-provision.yml; FR-3 observability leg already emits its named-keystroke hint in altifyai scripts/query-observability-logs.mjs lines 115-116. FR-1 load-bearing unknown is unaddressed by the SD repo split: the walker runs in EHG_Engineer, which has zero Worker-log/observability/D1 reach, while both readers live in altifyai.
critical_issues: FR-1 CROSS-REPO ACCESS PATH UNRESOLVED (must be settled before PRD): the stage-23 walker is lib/apa/journey-walk-orchestrator.js + lib/uat/result-recorder.js in EHG_Engineer, which has NO Worker-log, observability, or D1 reach. The only working observability reader is altifyai scripts/query-observability-logs.mjs (Workers Observability telemetry API) and the only D1 reader is altifyai .github/workflows/one-shot-d1-query.yml. The SD binding repo split assigns FR-1 to EHG_Engineer but never says how EHG_Engineer reaches Cloudflare. FR-1a and FR-1c are unbuildable until PLAN picks one of: (a) port the reader into EHG_Engineer, (b) gh-dispatch the altifyai workflow and read the run artifact, (c) drop FR-1a/1c to forwarded-feedback-rows only.

FR-4 SPEC CONFLICTS WITH MERGED CODE: FR-4 asks composeFailureDetail to persist a redacted message prefix. altifyai origin/main lib/alt-text/generate.js line 294 composeFailureDetail ALREADY EXISTS, its doc comment already cites FR-4, and it DELIBERATELY REFUSES to persist any provider message - it composes an allowlist (provider_status, provider_code, classification) precisely so no raw provider text reaches a sink (its own TS-10 rationale). Implementing FR-4 as literally written would REGRESS a shipped security decision. PLAN must restate FR-4 as capture.js-only.
warnings: QF-20260906-986 is status=completed (PR altifyai #94, commit 140e971) but only delivered HALF of FR-4. VERIFIED on origin/main: lib/error-capture/capture.js checkEnv() still console.warn's the forwarding-disabled line behind the warnedMissingEnv once-latch and forward() returns early; there is NO console.error of the redacted message. The only console.error in altifyai lib/ that PR #94 added is generate.js line 224 (failure_code+detail). So FR-4 capture.js local sink is genuinely NEW work; the FR-4 composeFailureDetail half is DONE.

FR-2 IS ROUGHLY 90 PERCENT PRE-WRITTEN, NOT NEW: altifyai .github/workflows/one-shot-secret-provision.yml already contains the exact idempotent fail-loud loop over EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_URL / EHG_ENGINEER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY / VENTURE_ID using npx wrangler secret put --name altifyai, refusing to write an empty secret. deploy.yml already carries the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID env pattern AND an idempotent-step precedent (wrangler d1 migrations apply). FR-2 equals lifting that block into deploy.yml. Estimate 20-25 LOC, not a new build.

FR-3 OBSERVABILITY LEG PARTLY EXISTS: altifyai scripts/query-observability-logs.mjs lines 112-118 already detects HTTP 403 and emits the exact named keystroke FR-3 wants (the token likely lacks Account > Workers Observability > Read; add it to the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret). The Workers AI leg has one-shot-ai-probe.yml (PR #92) which returned 401. FR-3 equals promoting two existing probes to a CI step, not authoring new probes.

NO SINGLE REUSABLE PROVENANCE PREDICATE FOR THE (producer, run id, content hash) TRIPLE ON UAT TABLES. lib/sub-agent-executor/evidence-provenance.js gradeProvenance() is the right shape but is hard-bound to sub_agent_execution_results (requires source in PRODUCER_ALLOWLIST, invocation_id, metadata.session_id, content_hash - columns uat_test_results does not have). The acceptance-artifact-gate predicate for uat_test_runs is presence-only on metadata.evidence_hash. FR-1 triple must be NEW on uat_test_results.metadata, modeled on gradeProvenance rather than reusing it.

DO NOT REUSE computeDedupHash FOR THE CONTENT-HASH LEG: lib/eva/corrective-finding-recorder.js line 42 computeDedupHash(sourceSdId, dimensions, gateRunIdOrTier) is a DEDUP KEY hash with no verification path. journey-walk-orchestrator.js lines 171-172 already misuses it as a bare sha256 primitive over JSON.stringify(outcome) to build evidenceManifest artifact_hashes. Extending that pattern would make the FR-1 content hash non-verifiable. Use lib/eva/artifact-versioning.js line 32 computeContentHash(content) instead - it has a matching verifyContentHash() re-derivation path at line 220.

QF-20260906-282 (completed, EHG_Engineer PR #8628, commit d0c543c3d82) ALREADY EDITED ALL FOUR FR-1 FILES: lib/apa/browser-executor.js, lib/apa/fixtures/alt-text-sample.png, lib/apa/journey-walk-orchestrator.js, lib/apa/venture-step-executors.js, lib/uat/result-recorder.js - adding metadata.provider_status / provider_elapsed_ms / provider_error_body_prefix to uat_test_results. That is a direct FR-1c precursor and the correct insertion point for FR-1 to EXTEND, not duplicate. QF-20260906-826 similarly added duration_ms + failure_category.

SEQUENCING: SD success criterion 4 requires QF-363/687/282/986 to stay ranked ahead in the venture lane. QF-20260906-363 (completed, altifyai PR #93), QF-20260906-282 (completed, PR #8628) and QF-20260906-986 (completed, PR #94) have landed, but QF-20260906-687 (AltifyAI usage-history recurrence) is STILL status=open with no PR and no claim. LEAD should confirm dispatching this SD does not displace 687.

The four REAL criteria live in success_criteria and all four carry measure=[UNPOPULATED]. Because success_criteria is only read as a FALLBACK when success_metrics is empty (and it is not), the gate never examines those markers. PLAN should populate success_criteria measure fields from the plan Exit predicate (CI form) clause.

metadata.needs_enrichment lists key_changes, strategic_objectives, risks - the SD self-flags these three as unenriched; all key_changes impact fields are [UNPOPULATED] and strategic_objectives are template text.

MINOR: the applications table holds TWO rows named AltifyAI (one active, one inactive), both with local_path C:/Users/rickf/Projects/_EHG/altifyai. Any resolver doing a single-row lookup by name is ambiguous; the SUB_AGENT_REPO_RESOLUTION view compares metadata->>repo_path to applications.local_path.
recommendations: PLAN DECISION 1 (blocks PRD): choose the FR-1 Cloudflare access path. Recommended option (b): have the walker gh-dispatch altifyai existing one-shot-observability-query.yml / one-shot-d1-query.yml and attach the run id + artifact hash. This reuses two working readers, keeps the Cloudflare token scope inside altifyai where it already lives, and yields a natural run id for the provenance triple. Option (a) porting the reader into EHG_Engineer adds a NEW credential surface (though note lib/operator/cloudflare-cost-adapter.js already reads CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID in EHG_Engineer, so the env vars exist).

RESTATE FR-4 in the PRD as capture.js-only: lib/error-capture/capture.js console.errors the redacted message when forwarding is disabled. Mark the composeFailureDetail clause DELIVERED by QF-20260906-986 / PR #94 and cross-cite it. Do NOT add a raw-message prefix to composeFailureDetail.

RESCOPE FR-2 and FR-3 downward to promote existing one-shot workflow steps into deploy.yml / CI rather than author new provisioning and probe steps. Both have working implementations on altifyai origin/main; this materially shrinks the altifyai-side PR and keeps it inside the 100 LOC target.

FR-1 should EXTEND the QF-282 insertion point in lib/uat/result-recorder.js recordResult() (the same metadata block that already takes providerResponseClass) rather than opening a new write path. Add captured_cause as a uat_test_results.metadata sub-key alongside provider_status/failure_category.

KEEP target_application = EHG_Engineer. Precedent is direct and measured: altifyai own deploy.yml carries comments citing SD-LEO-FIX-ALTIFYAI-LIVE-SITE-001 and SD-LEO-INFRA-ALTIFYAI-PRICING-CHECKOUT-001, both of which are target_application=EHG_Engineer SDs whose code landed in altifyai. The gated, testable half (walker + probe) is in EHG_Engineer.

TRAP PLAN MUST KNOW: do NOT set metadata.target_repos to [altifyai] expecting the altifyai half to be scanned. lib/sub-agents/repo-target-resolver.js computeReposForSD() builds its candidate set from ONLY rickfelix/ehg + rickfelix/EHG_Engineer, so a Tier-1 allowlist of [altifyai] filters to zero and SILENTLY falls through to Tier 2, which returns EHG_Engineer only (target_application includes engineer). The altifyai PRs will be invisible to GATE_PR_MERGE_REPO_SCOPE either way, so FR-2/3/4/6 need their own completion evidence (PR URL + commit sha cross-cited on the SD), not merge-scope gate coverage.

Populate success_criteria measure fields with the plan own CI-form exit predicate: a test asserts a failed journey result row carries captured_cause with provenance (producer, run id, content hash), and the Deploy run fails when a forwarding secret is missing.

Consider decomposing into two children along the repo seam (EHG_Engineer: FR-1/FR-5; altifyai: FR-2/FR-3/FR-4/FR-6) so each gets its own PR-merge verification. Not required, but the repo-target-resolver limitation above makes single-SD cross-repo completion evidence manual.
detailed_analysis:
CHECK 1 - DUPLICATE/OVERLAPPING SDs. Swept strategic_directives_v2 title+description across 24 scope terms (journey walk, stage-23, venture telemetry, error capture, wrangler, cloudflare, altifyai, captured_cause, venture_error, observability, worker log, secret put, troubleshoot, lib/apa, lib/uat, walker, provenance, evidence_hash, content hash, completion-ready, deploy workflow). 332 raw matches, of which only 6 are NON-TERMINAL: (1) this SD itself; (2) SD-LEO-INFRA-E2E-VERIFICATION-ROBUSTNESS-001-C, deferred/LEAD, altifyai contamination-scan.test.js SyntaxError - DISPOSITION unrelated (test-file syntax, not telemetry); (3) SD-ALTIFYAI-LEO-ORCH-SPRINT-2026-002, active/PLAN_VERIFICATION, Sprint 2026-08-28 parent - DISPOSITION: parent of the already-COMPLETED children F/F1 (Wire Error Capture Middleware) that BUILT altifyai lib/error-capture; it is the ancestor of the code FR-4 modifies, not a competitor for it; no overlap with FR-1; (4) SD-LEO-GEN-ALTIFYAI-FIRST-CUSTOMER-001, active/EXEC, customer acquisition - DISPOSITION unrelated (demand, not telemetry); (5) SD-ALTIFYAI-LEO-ORCH-SPRINT-2026-001-I, deferred, chairman decision card - DISPOSITION unrelated; (6) SD-LEO-FEAT-COMPETITIVE-VIGILANCE-OBSERVED-BASELINE-001, deferred, matched on the generic word provenance - DISPOSITION false positive. NO BLOCKING DUPLICATE. The closest COMPLETED ancestors that establish (not duplicate) this work: SD-LEO-INFRA-STAGE23-WALKER-ELEVEN-OVERRIDES-001 (built the per-step stepOverrides in venture-step-executors.js), SD-LEO-INFRA-FIX-JOURNEY-WALK-001 (fixed the swallowed-exception path), SD-LEO-INFRA-RECORD-VENTURE-ERROR-DEFINER-POSTURE-001 (hardened the record_venture_error RPC), SD-ALTIFYAI-LEO-ORCH-SPRINT-2026-002-F/F1 (built lib/error-capture). CONFIRMED: git grep for captured_cause and capturedCause over all tracked files returns EMPTY - the FR-1 core field is genuinely new.

CHECK 2 - THE FOUR QFs (quick_fixes has NO qf_key column; the QF key IS the id column - a qf_key query errors out and reads as absence). QF-20260906-986: COMPLETED 2026-09-07T21:01Z, altifyai PR #94, commit 140e971 - PARTIALLY DELIVERS FR-4. Verified against altifyai origin/main: composeFailureDetail (generate.js line 294) exists with a doc comment literally headed FR-4, and generate.js line 224 console.errors failure_code+detail. But capture.js checkEnv() still only console.warn's once and forward() returns - NO local console.error of the redacted message. So FR-4 is half-done. QF-20260906-282: COMPLETED 2026-09-08T07:10Z, EHG_Engineer PR #8628, files_changed = lib/apa/browser-executor.js, lib/apa/fixtures/alt-text-sample.png, lib/apa/journey-walk-orchestrator.js, lib/apa/venture-step-executors.js, lib/uat/result-recorder.js, plus 2 unit tests - adds provider response class to uat_test_results.metadata. FR-1c precursor, same files. QF-20260906-363: COMPLETED 2026-09-07T20:31Z, altifyai PR #93, commit 8be9b9d - navigation defect, explicitly out of scope. QF-20260906-687: OPEN, AltifyAI, no PR, no claim, no disposition - the usage-history recurrence, explicitly out of scope but named in success criterion 4 as ranked AHEAD of this SD.

CHECK 3 - REUSABLE INFRASTRUCTURE FOR FR-1. REUSABLE: (a) lib/eva/artifact-versioning.js line 32 computeContentHash(content) plus line 220 verifyContentHash() - the only content hash with a re-derivation path; use for the content-hash leg. (b) lib/uat/result-recorder.js already writes uat_test_runs.metadata.evidence_hash (via computeSubstantiveEvidenceHash, conditional on an evidenceManifest being supplied) and metadata.commit_sha and metadata.env_snapshot_at (an object with stamped_at/mtime/sha256_16, NOT a boolean); uat_test_results carries real columns failure_category and duration_ms plus metadata.provider_status/provider_elapsed_ms/provider_error_body_prefix. (c) altifyai scripts/query-observability-logs.mjs - a working Workers Observability telemetry reader with 403 scope-naming; altifyai wrangler.toml has observability enabled since 1d2edb1 with 3-day (free) / 7-day (paid) retention. (d) altifyai one-shot-secret-provision.yml, one-shot-d1-query.yml, one-shot-ai-probe.yml, one-shot-observability-query.yml and one-shot-wrangler-tail.yml are ALL present on origin/main. MUST BE NEW: (i) captured_cause itself; (ii) a provenance predicate for uat tables - gradeProvenance() cannot be reused (bound to sub_agent_execution_results columns invocation_id/session_id/content_hash that uat_test_results lacks); (iii) any Cloudflare reach from EHG_Engineer for logs or D1 - EHG_Engineer only Cloudflare clients are lib/operator/cloudflare-cost-adapter.js (GraphQL usage counts, no logs), lib/venture-acquisition/dns-wiring.js and lib/venture-email/cf-email-routing.js; none reads Worker logs and no wrangler-tail code exists anywhere in lib/ or scripts/; (iv) a reader for feedback rows with feedback_type=venture_error - the ONLY existing reader is lib/eva/utils/validate-venture-default-capabilities.js line 117 verifyCapabilityWired(), a limit(1) existence check that never reads error CONTENT; (v) FR-5 wiring - lib/fleet/parent-completion.mjs reads only strategic_directives_v2 and sd_phase_handoffs, and lib/governance/venture-build-status.mjs reads only ventures and venture_deployments; NEITHER touches uat_test_runs or uat_test_results today, so both are fresh integration points, not extensions.

CHECK 4 - GATE PLUS target_application. GATE_SD_TRANSITION_READINESS (scripts/modules/handoff/executors/lead-to-plan/gates/transition-readiness.js) will PASS at roughly 100/100: Check1 title and description present; Check2 status draft is in validStatuses; Check3 zero prior LEAD-TO-PLAN handoff rows for this sd_id; Check5 reads success_metrics FIRST and it holds 3 structurally valid metric/target entries, so the success_criteria fallback (and therefore the four measure=[UNPOPULATED] markers) is NEVER examined and no marker penalty applies. The gate returns pass/score/max_score; validateGateResult() in scripts/modules/handoff/validation/gate-result-schema.js explicitly auto-corrects pass to passed and max_score to maxScore, so there is NO normalizer mismatch and no gate bug. Backlog: this SD has 0 sd_backlog_map rows, but so do 14 of the 15 most recent COMPLETED SD-LEO-INFRA-* SDs - 0-backlog is the established convention for this SD class, the scope carrier is metadata.plan_content FR-1 through FR-6, and the generic one-or-more-backlog-item rule does NOT bind here. target_application: KEEP EHG_Engineer (precedent plus the gated half), with the repo-target-resolver caveat documented in recommendations.

CHECK 5 - CONFLICTS. sd_conflict_matrix is an EMPTY TABLE (zero rows overall), so it yields no signal either for or against - it is not evidence of no conflict. Scanned all 60 open rickfelix/EHG_Engineer PRs; every title matching apa, uat, walk, stage-23, venture, altifyai, observab or cloudflare is a changelog/docs-only PR (#8489, #8411, #8410, #8407, #8404, #8303, #8267, #8254, #8242, #8228, #8216, #7674, #7643, #7636, #7622, #7578, #7342). NO open PR carries live code in lib/apa or lib/uat. This SD has zero handoffs, zero PRDs, and zero prior sub_agent_execution_results rows - clean slate.

EXTENT AND BOUNDS: every claim above was measured directly against the DB or against altifyai origin/main at 140e971 and EHG_Engineer main at 2eb963cc060. The ONE dimension I could not measure exhaustively: per-file diffs of all 60 open PRs (the gh --json files field returned no usable file lists), so the claim that no open PR touches lib/apa or lib/uat rests on a title-and-branch scan, not a file scan.
